consultation.title: Need help transforming your business?
consultation.description: Schedule a one-on-one session with our enterprise architects to discuss your bottlenecks, goals, and technical feasibility.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: Project timelines vary depending on complexity. A standard corporate website takes 2-4 weeks, while a custom ERP or SaaS platform can take 3-6 months. We provide precise timelines during the technical discovery phase.
Yes. While our core market is Africa, we deliver enterprise solutions for clients globally, ensuring timezone overlaps for critical meetings.
Absolutely. EINORT ERP is built modularly. We tailor workflows, dashboards, and integrations specifically for your business operations.

items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: Costs depend on scope, features, and integrations. We build premium, high-converting platforms rather than generic templates. Contact us for a precise quotation.

items.q: How do I request a quotation?
items.a: Fill out the contact form above with details about your project, and our architecture team will respond within 24 hours to schedule a discovery call.

items.q: Can you redesign an existing system?
items.a: Yes. We specialize in digital transformation, taking legacy systems and upgrading them to modern, scalable, and beautifully designed cloud applications.
